text_block_list.text: One afternoon...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Dun cha cha, dun cha...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh... What a fun little tune.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What d'ya mean "little"?! This is the
rhythm of the
sun that courses through
my veins!

Wonder! Amazement! Surprise! El
Condor Pasa
takes the stage!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I thought that might be you, El
Condor Pa—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hark, a dance floor ministered by angels
on high!
A dance to warm your very soul
shall soon
commence!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: There's more?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Non non! It's not over yet! Free your soul
with this
innovative contemporary dance!
text_block_list.name: Сикинг зе Пёрл

text_block_list.text:
Bueno! The free-for-all dance match is
about to
begin! Start dancing or you
lose!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: ...Wh-what?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Or maybe you wanna watch from the
sidelines? I
guess that's one way to live.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If you wanna lose by default, I'll just soar
away.
Hasta luego! ☆
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Like I would lose without a
fight!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
H-hold it! I'll show you first-rate dance
skills
cultivated over years of effort!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! There's the King I know! Her
indomitable
spirit is alive and well!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Dun cha cha, dun cha...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Cha cha... dun...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Huh? There's no one here... Was that
all... a
dream?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I must've been really tired to have such an odd dream.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Dun cha cha, dun cha...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Now it's stuck in my head...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Why am I still hearing it?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Could I have gained some special
psychic sense?
But if that's the case...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What on earth have I opened my mind
up to?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's running over the next few
days
becomes even more rhythmic and
smooth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
